=={{header|ghul}}==

<syntaxhighlight lang="ghul">
use IO.Std.write_line;

binary(value: int) -> string is
    if value == 0 then
        return "0";
    fi

    let digits = System.Text.StringBuilder();
    let remaining mut = value;

    while remaining > 0 do
        digits.insert(0, remaining % 2);
        remaining = remaining / 2;
    od

    return digits.to_string();
si

for value in [5, 50, 9000] do
    write_line(binary(value));
od
</syntaxhighlight>

{{out}}
<pre>
101
110010
10001100101000
</pre>
